AI_SEARCH.description: Default Cloudflare AI Search namespace. The Worker automatically opens or creates the built-in notesflash-search hybrid keyword/vector instance.

CHUNK_INDEX.description: Legacy line-level semantic fallback. EmbeddingGemma vectors with **768 dimensions** and the **cosine** metric.

VECTOR_INDEX.description: Legacy note-level index (**1024 dimensions**, **cosine**). Only used to clean up vectors from older releases.

scripts.deploy: npm run vectorize:ensure && npm run db:migrate:remote && wrangler deploy
